Lorath and I have secured passage on a ship bound for Skovos, but Mephisto is already one step ahead of us. We must reach the isles quickly to stop whatever the Lord of Hatred has planned.
Mephisto! He spoke to me through the Hand of Akarat. He knows I am on his trail, and he has summoned a grotesque abomination to send me to a watery grave.
